description: Idempotent VPS automation over SSH with TypeScript playbooks, a CLI, and project scaffolding.
rules: Treat packages/paratix/llm-guide.md as the normative API and module reference.
Import the core API from paratix and built-in modules from paratix/modules.
For idempotency with command.shell(), always provide a check command.
Use shellQuote() whenever dynamic values are interpolated into shell commands.
In strict file.template() templates, every placeholder must use an explicit modifier; use shell for shell output.
